title: Formal Policy Enforcement for Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2602.16708v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As agentic computing systems grow increasingly popular, they raise serious security concerns due to their susceptibility to various attacks. While prior research efforts aim to mitigate these concerns, they are often too coarse-grained and offer no formal correctness guarantees. In this work, we present a novel approach to agentic security based on runtime monitoring. Our method allows the user to specify their intended policy in Datalog and enforces the specified policy at runtime by constructing event graphs. When an agent is about to execute an action such as a tool call, our approach determines whether the action would violate the policy in light of the current system state and the history of past events. The action is then blocked or permitted accordingly. We implemented our approach and evaluated it across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating its merits in real-world settings. translated_title: 智能体系统的形式化策略执行
translated_abstract: 随着智能体计算系统日益普及，由于其容易受到各类攻击，引发了严重的安全问题。尽管以往的研究工作旨在缓解这些安全隐患，但它们通常过于粗粒度，且缺乏形式化的正确性保证。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于运行时监控的智能体安全新方法。该方法允许用户使用Datalog语言指定其预期的安全策略，并通过构建事件图在运行时强制执行所指定的策略。当智能体即将执行某个动作（如工具调用）时，我们的方法会结合当前系统状态和历史事件记录，判断该动作是否会违反策略，并相应地阻止或允许该动作的执行。我们实现了该方法，并在多个基准测试上进行了评估，证明了其在真实场景中的有效性。我们将这项工作视为迈向智能体系统安全的重要一步。
tldr: 提出了一种基于Datalog策略规范与事件图的运行时监控方法，能够在智能体执行动作前判断其是否违反策略，从而为智能体系统提供具备形式化保证的细粒度安全防护。
en_tdlr: Proposes a runtime monitoring approach that uses Datalog policy specification and event graphs to check agent actions against policies before execution, providing fine-grained, formally grounded security enforcement for agentic systems.
